zh_cn.enchantment.openblocks_reborn.last_stand: 图腾优先；未获救时，经验足够便扣经验抵挡致命伤害。
zh_cn.enchantment.openblocks_reborn.unstable.d: 消耗火药制造爆炸；靴子还可借摔落弹射。默认不破坏方块。
玩家战斗中的恶作剧与反制附魔。各项恶作剧默认关闭。
zh_cn.tooltip.openblocks_reborn.enchantment_di: 当前未启用此附魔的效果
zh_cn.message.openblocks_reborn.book.enchantme: 屹立不倒（I–II）附在护甲上。玩家真正受到致命伤害时，先由不死图腾正常判定；图腾没有救活，才尝试消耗经验，把生命恢复到半颗心。普通的非致命伤害不会触发，黄色吸收生命也会先参与伤害结算。虚空和命令造成的伤害同样允许尝试，但经验不足时不会救活，也不会扣除部分费用。消耗的是经验点，不是经验等级。基础费用按伤害结算后的生命缺口计算：50 ×（1 − 预计受伤后生命）÷ 全身护甲附魔等级之和，乘以配置倍率后向上取整，最低 1 点经验。极高伤害需要的经验也会很高。效果默认开启，经验倍率默认 1，可调 0.1–10；触发冷却默认 0 秒，可调 0–600 秒。只有成功触发本附魔才开始冷却，图腾生效和失败的尝试不会开始冷却。

震荡不定（I–III）附在护甲上。靴子佩戴者从超过 4 格高度落下且没有潜行时，消耗火药制造爆炸，抵消此次摔落并向上弹射。头盔、胸甲或护腿佩戴者受到实体伤害时也会爆炸。I、II、III 级分别消耗 1、2、4 个火药，并损耗触发装备的耐久。基础爆炸强度分别为 2、3、4，TNT 的强度为 4。配置倍率可调 0.25–2，最终强度限制在 0.5–8。效果默认开启，强度倍率默认 1，默认不破坏方块。开启破坏方块后，也只有 III 级可破坏地形。爆炸仍会伤害附近实体，请留意同伴与动物。

尔虞我诈（I–IV）可附在武器与护甲上，是玩家战斗中的恶作剧附魔。武器等级与目标全身护甲等级总和的三分之一（向下取整）比较，较弱一方积累厄运；相等则不积累。高防护的对手可能让攻击者自己倒霉。它不是原版诅咒，不会仅因穿戴就持续惩罚玩家。总开关默认开启，但交换快捷栏、向上弹射、反胃、缓慢、物品改名和随机传送六项效果默认全部关闭，可分别启用。全部关闭时，不积累厄运，也没有恶作剧音效和提示。启用效果后，厄运达到阈值时每秒有四分之一概率发动已开启的恶作剧，成功后有 15 秒冷却。三个附魔默认都不是宝藏附魔，可在附魔台获取；各自的宝藏属性可单独配置。宝藏模式不从附魔台出现，仍允许交易和相应随机战利品途径。
zh_cn.config.openblocks_reborn.rescueCooldown: 触发冷却秒数（0–600，0 为关闭）
zh_cn.config.openblocks_reborn.explosionBlockD: 允许 III 级破坏方块

en_us.enchantment.openblocks_reborn.last_stand: After totems fail, spends sufficient XP to survive lethal damage.
en_us.enchantment.openblocks_reborn.unstable.d: Consumes gunpowder to explode; boots also launch on falls. No terrain damage by default.
PvP pranks and counterplay. Each prank is disabled by default.
en_us.tooltip.openblocks_reborn.enchantment_di: No effects of this enchantment are currently enabled
en_us.message.openblocks_reborn.book.enchantme: Last Stand (I–II) goes on armor. When damage actually kills a player, vanilla totems get the first chance to save them. Only if no totem saved the player does Last Stand attempt to spend XP and restore one health point. Nonlethal hits never trigger it, and absorption is processed first. All damage sources, including void and commands, are eligible, but insufficient XP means no rescue and no partial charge. Costs use XP points rather than levels: ceil(50 * (1 - projected health after damage) / combined armor enchantment levels * configured multiplier), minimum one point. Very large hits can be very expensive. The effect defaults on, with multiplier 1 (range 0.1–10). Cooldown defaults to zero, with a range of 0–600 seconds. Only a successful Last Stand rescue starts its cooldown; totems and failed attempts do not.

Unstable (I–III) goes on armor. Boots consume gunpowder when falling more than four blocks without sneaking, canceling the fall and launching their wearer in an explosion. Enchanted helmets, chestplates and leggings also explode when an entity hurts the wearer. Levels I/II/III consume 1/2/4 gunpowder and damage the triggering armor. Base explosion powers are 2/3/4; TNT has power 4. The configurable multiplier ranges from 0.25 to 2, with final power bounded to 0.5–8. The effect defaults on, multiplier 1, with terrain destruction off. Enabling terrain damage permits only level III to destroy blocks. Nearby entities can still be hurt.

Flim Flam (I–IV) works on weapons and armor in player combat. Weapon level contests one third of the defender's combined armor levels, rounded down. The weaker side accumulates bad luck; equal levels add none. Strong armor can turn a prank back on the attacker. This is not a vanilla curse that constantly penalizes its wearer. The master switch defaults on, but all six prank options default off: shuffle hotbar, launch upwards, nausea, slowness, rename held item and random teleport. With none selected, no luck penalties, prank sounds or messages occur. With effects selected, sufficient bad luck gives a one-in-four check each second, followed by a 15-second cooldown after a prank. All three enchantments default to non-treasure and can appear at the enchanting table. Each treasure setting is configurable; treasure mode excludes the table while retaining trades and applicable random-loot paths.
